req.title: Unsupported methods rejected
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using an unsupported method against /tasks/{task_id}.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-026 requires HTTP 405 for unsupported HTTP methods on /tasks/{task_id}. The endpoint supports GET, PUT, DELETE. Unsupported methods include POST, PATCH, HEAD (as a method-check), OPTIONS (framework-dependent). Tests cover: (1) positive — supported method GET returns 200, confirming the endpoint is live and method-routing works; (2) negative — POST to /tasks/{task_id} returns 405; (3) boundary — PATCH to /tasks/{task_id} returns 405; (4) DT — multiple unsupported methods each independently yield 405; (5) NEG — verifying the exact 405 constant, not 404 or 400. Mutation resilience: exact status code assertions (405 vs 404/400/200), both sides of the method-routing decision tested, exact constant 405 used in every negative assertion.

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_multiple_unsupported_methods_all_return_405():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r_post = client.post("/tasks/2", json={"title": "Book flight tickets", "completed": True})
    assert r_post.status_code == 405
    r_patch = client.patch("/tasks/2", json={"completed": False})
    assert r_patch.status_code == 405
    assert r_post.status_code == r_patch.status_code

test_multiple_unsupported_methods_all_return_405()

def test_supported_put_method_does_not_return_405():

    payload = {"title": "Submit expense report", "description": "Updated", "completed": False}
